RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 25

Raising allegations of bias based solely on the panel's gender composition is legally tenuous and would severely damage your professional reputation. In leadership positions like group head, commercial acumen, interview performance, and proven client management frequently outweigh sheer technical seniority or years of design work. An all-women panel is not evidence of discrimination, just as all-men panels are not inherently discriminatory. 

Additionally, two weeks is a standard turnaround window for corporate HR. Instead of challenging the panel's demographics, send a professional follow-up requesting constructive feedback on how you can strengthen your profile for future executive opportunities.
